note: Post formats and the offline copy bank. `features` is the only list the copy generator may draw claims from — it mirrors the app's sidebar (src/components/Sidebar.tsx), so adding a tool here without adding it to the app puts a false claim on a post.
features: Screenshot — full screen, area or window capture, plus screen recording, with an editor for annotation before you share
Mirror — put a live camera preview on screen, with a studio light panel for lighting
Clipboard — searchable clipboard history you can pin and paste back
Sticky Notes — floating notes that stay above other windows, with export
System Monitor — CPU, memory, disk, network and battery readings in the menu bar
Keep Awake — stop the Mac sleeping for a set time or until you turn it off
New File — create a new file of any type in the current Finder folder
Convert — rename and convert image, audio and video files locally, no upload
Color Picker — pick any colour on screen and copy it as HEX, RGB or HSL
Pomodoro — focus timer with a floating widget
Screen Draw — draw straight onto the screen over any app
Clean Mode — lock the keyboard and trackpad so you can wipe them
Macros — record and replay keystroke and click sequences, per active app
Quick Action — a radial shortcut ring that opens any tool from anywhere
